Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring plan request: FP&A + RevOps + Billing Ops (Q3 hires)

Team —

I want to get formal approval to proceed with three headcount items we discussed at the leadership review:

1) Senior FP&A (IC) — workload: financial planning and GTM analytics for EMEA expansion. Suggested band: $150k–$185k OTE (base + performance). Target start: mid-August.
2) RevOps Manager — responsible for GTM tooling and automation, onboarding playbooks, and quota ops. Suggested band: $140k–$170k. Target start: early September.
3) Billing Ops Specialist — focus on refunds, escalation playbooks, invoicing automation (AR). Suggested band: $95k–$120k. Target start: July 15 (urgent).

Attachments: headcount_worksheet_Q3.xlsx; JD_Senior_FPNA.pdf; JD_RevOps_Manager.pdf; JD_Billing_Ops_Specialist.pdf

Ask: please confirm budget availability and final comp bands so we can instruct TalentBridge to move to offers (we have candidates in pipeline for all three). If approved, I'll route offer templates for sign-off and instruct TA to extend conditional offers subject to background checks.

Budget notes: I allocated against cost centers CC-FIN-02 (FP&A) and CC-GTM-03 (RevOps). Billing Ops will sit under RevOps for now but may move to Finance in FY27.

If any band adjustments are needed, call them out inline. If all good, reply with approvals and any constraints (signing bonus cap, approval authority, negotiation room).

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Markus —

Thanks for the clear summary and the worksheet. I reviewed the numbers with FP&A and we can cover the three roles within the Q3 hiring envelope with one caveat: the Senior FP&A role is underspecified for market comp at your low end. Recommend adjusting the Senior FP&A band to $165k–$200k (base) given current competitive offers in SF/NY market. That pushes run-rate up ~7% but still within budget if we reduce contractor spend in Q3.

Quick notes:
- Approved: Billing Ops Specialist (range confirmed $95k–$120k).
- Approved: RevOps Manager (range confirmed $140k–$170k) pending Vivek's sign-off on level.
- Senior FP&A: propose $165k–$200k band. If we stick to $150k base we'll struggle to close candidates.

Please see attached approved_budget_lineitem.pdf — I've marked the chart lines we will draw the budget from.

If you want, I can escalate to the CFO for a one-time signing bonus allowance up to $15k for hard-to-fill FP&A candidates. Otherwise, keep comps within bands and offer equity per the standard LTI table.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

I've attached the offer_matrix_revops.csv with the standard offer templates and approval flow (use the RevOps column for routing).

Go ahead and instruct TalentBridge to prepare offers with the bands above; they should hold offers until we confirm final sign-on language and we will aim to close all in the next 10 business days.

Thanks —
